title: 鋼の甲羅
caption: heavy sludgy half-time industrial boss song, sudden snapping hits, deep low brass, rusty metal clangs, crushing chorus, industrial metallic percussion, rain, city pop electric piano, funk, rusty factory, female duet, a powerful husky rock diva and a bright high sweet girl trading lines, Japanese lyrics, Japanese anime song, J-pop royal road progression, bittersweet melancholic yet uplifting, sorrowful piano and strings fused with breakbeat groove, ethereal reverb, upfront vocal
lyrics:
[Intro - rain and metal clangs]

[Verse 1]
濁った水に 沈む影
苔むす岩か 眠る鋼
一瞬で閉じる 顎の枷
息を殺して 待つ雨

[Pre-Chorus]
近づくほどに 重くなる
鼓動が雨を 打ち鳴らす

[Chorus]
砕け 砕け その甲羅ごと
怯まず 進め 雨の中を
噛みつく牙を すり抜けて
錆びた夜明けを 掴み取れ

[Instrumental Break - heavy half-time drums and low brass]

[Chorus]
砕け 砕け その甲羅ごと
怯まず 進め 雨の中を
噛みつく牙を すり抜けて
錆びた夜明けを 掴み取れ

[Outro - rain]
